messages.content: 今天美國的黃金價格是多少？

function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Face_Value.description: The face value of the bond. This is a float type value.

Coupon_rate.description: The coupon rate of the bond. This is a float type value.

Required_return.description: The required rate of return on the bond. This is a float type value.

maturity_years.description: The number of years to maturity of the bond.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若想知道今天美國黃金（通常指COMEX黃金期貨或現貨黃金）的即時價格，建議您參考以下可靠來源：

| 平台 | 特色 | 連結 |
|------|------|------|
| Bloomberg | 24/7 金融新聞與實時行情 | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets |
| Reuters | 全球金融市場即時報價 | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities |
| Kitco | 黃金、白銀等貴金屬即時價格與歷史圖表 | https://www.kitco.com |
| CME Group (COMEX) | 黃金期貨合約價格 | https://www.cmegroup.com/trading/metals/gold.html |
| Investing.com | 多種黃金價格來源與技術分析 | https://www.investing.com/commodities/gold |

您也可以直接在手機或電腦的金融新聞 App（如 Bloomberg、Reuters、CNBC 等）搜尋「Gold」或「黃金」來快速查看最新價格。祝您投資順利！
message.reasoning: The user asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" (What is today's gold price in the US?). They want the current price. We don't have real-time data. We can respond that we don't have real-time data. We can suggest checking reliable sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, or the COMEX. We can provide approximate recent price if known. But we should not fabricate. We can say we don't have real-time data. Provide guidance.
